entities.summary: Amina Temitope Ajayi is a US-based Nigerian businesswoman and accountant. A former president of the All Nigerian American Congress (ANAC), her advocacy on issues concerning Nigerians in Diaspora has earned her media attention as well as dubbed "Mama Diaspora".
